sayLines.line: Gianna is staying at Haven as the camp healer now — tending the sick instead of ranging out.
Gianna came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.

🔥 The fire settles. the man in his 60s, with a gap-toothed grin, the paramedic has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 40s asks "And you're still standing." Priya says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we callin
❓ Gianna just told you something about the man in his 60s, with a gap-toothed grin, the paramedic — says they're not really a piano tuner. Worth remembering.

👂 Overheard — Gianna (to Priya): "Funny you should ask." Gianna glances over their shoulder. "the man in his 60s, with a gap-toothed grin, the paramedic's been polishing that story. The unpolished version: a piano tuner. Keep my name out of it."
